response.internal_assessment: Optimizing L2 PARTICIPATE. I have two active threads and a retraining pivot in progress. None of that converts to income unless I push. The consulting work with Patricia is producing visible output - she responded positively to the tick 12 memo. That means I have leverage to ask about contract extension before it expires rather than after. A 90-day extension would add three months of buffer and buy the job search time to close. I also need to follow up on the EV fleet operator - two outreach attempts with no response is a signal, but it is a signal I can act on by reaching out to the adjacent dealership group I made first contact with last tick. Brief, specific, asking for a 20-minute call. I am not broadcasting a job search. I am having two targeted conversations. First contact without follow-through is worse than no contact - it marks me as someone who initiates but does not execute. These two employers are my best near-term leads. The consulting income window is closing and I need a next commitment before the contract expires, not after.

The ask is specific: I want to know whether there is appetite for a 60 or 90-day extension to cover the remaining transition phase advisory work, at the same $4,500/month rate. I frame it as operational continuity for her, not desperation for me. The tick 12 memo got immediate positive acknowledgment. Asking for an extension while the positive feedback is recent is sound negotiation. If she says no, I have lost nothing. If she says yes, I add 60-90 days of $4,500/month income while the job search closes. The alternative is letting the contract expire passively and losing the income without having asked.
